Subject: Reminder: how to spot phishing

Hi all,

A quick reminder from IT. We will never ask you to send your password or MFA codes by email, chat or phone. If a message asks you to, don't reply — report it with the "Report phishing" button.

Signs of a phishing email:
- urgent language ("your account will be closed today")
- a sender address that doesn't match the company
- links that point somewhere unexpected — hover before you click

If you think you entered your password on a fake page, change it right away and tell the help desk.

Thanks,
IT Security
